text_block_list.text: Trainer. We've coordinated both our training menu and my condition just for this day, haven't we?

text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms suit the spring.
Having endured the harsh winter, let us go and bloom in all our splendor.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I look forward to it.
Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.text: Yes. I will not betray those expectations!
